newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bills yields steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bills yields steady to higher.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills stood at 57.30 percent, the same as at the last sale on August 27, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Auction Number 131 127
Issue date August 29, 1996 August 27, 1996
Maturity date November 28, 1996 November 27, 1996
Denominations 10 million UAK 10 million UAK
Amount sold 589.4 billion UAK 735.9 billion UAK
Actual amount raised 515.7 billion UAK 643.9 billion UAK
Average yield 57.30 pct 57.30 pct
Average price 8.750 million UAK 8.750 million UAK
Cut-off price 8.750 million UAK 8.750 million UAK
Ukraine's central bank sold 58,948 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 45,763 were competitive and 13,185 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of discount three-month T-bills is unfixed.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills rose to 64.87 percent from 59.90 percent at the last sale on August 27, a central bank statement said.
Results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Auction Number 132 128
Issue date August 29, 1996 August 27, 1996
Maturity date February 27, 1997 February 26, 1996
Denominations 10 million UAK 10 million UAK
Amount sold 692.9 billion UAK 312.7 billion UAK
Actual amount raised 523.5 billion UAK 240.8 billion UAK
Average yield 64.87 pct 59.90 pct
Average price 7.556 million UAK 7.700 million UAK
Cut-off price 7.550 million UAK 7.700 million UAK
Of the 69,291 T-bills sold by the central bank, 69,020 were competitive and 271 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is not set.
Auctions of nine-month and 12-month discount T-bills were also scheduled for Thursday but were cancelled by the Finance Ministry.
